description: This file defines a Flutter widget called BookmarkScreen, which displays a grid of product cards representing wishlisted items. It integrates with a WishlistViewModel for state management and uses Flutter's widget tree for layout.

classes.name: BookmarkScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a grid of wishlisted products.

methods.name: _productId
methods.description: Generates a unique product ID string based on the product's brand, title, and image.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the BookmarkScreen, displaying a scrolling grid of product cards.
